description.en: CLIP-CC-Bench evaluates paragraph-level video description quality using 5-hour movie content and expert-written references. It scores 17 VLMs via coarse- and fine-grained semantic matching with five LLM-based embedding judges.

evidence.snippet: We introduce CLIP-CC-Bench, an evaluation suite for long-form video description built from 5 hours of movie content segmented into 90-second clips, each paired with an expert-written paragraph-style reference.

claire_radar.motivation: Benchmarking video-language models has largely focused on short clips and single-sentence metrics, leaving open whether current systems can generate accurate long-form, paragraph-level descriptions.
